title: Tiberian Factions for Red Alert
description:
[i]My son asked me who would win if GDI battled the Soviets. Now we can find out.[/i]

Tiberian Factions adds GDI and Nod from Tiberian Dawn, and GDI from Tiberian Sun, as fully playable factions in Red Alert Remastered. Five sides, one map: Allies, Soviets, GDI, Nod and TS GDI, in any mix, for you and the AI.

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]GDI and Nod with full TD logic.[/b] Complete TD tech trees and rosters: Ion Cannon, Nuclear Strike, Obelisk of Light, flame and stealth tanks, Orca, Apache and the A-10 bombing run. Navies too (GDI Naval Yard: gunboat, destroyer, cruiser; Nod Sub Pen: attack and missile subs), plus the GDI GPS satellite and Nod's spy plane and paratroopers. Nod's Stealth Generator cloaks your base, and the Flame Bunker guards it.
[*] [b]New in 5.0: Tiberian Sun GDI, a fifth faction.[/b] Its own TS tech tree and army: Titan, Wolverine, Disruptor, Juggernaut, Hover MLRS, Ghost Stalker, Jumpjet Infantry, Orcas and the Carryall, the Mammoth Mk. II by dropship, plus Firestorm Defense, the EMP Cannon, the Hunter Seeker, drop pods, the Ion Cannon, the Mobile War Factory and component towers with Vulcan, RPG and SAM upgrades.
[*] [b]Every faction looks like itself.[/b] GDI and Nod play on Tiberian Dawn's sidebar, and every faction gets its own radar crest, sidebar tabs and EVA voice, on LAN too. The lobby picker shows each faction's emblem.
[*] [b]All-new intro movie and UI overhaul:[/b] the Tiberian Factions title, main menu, loading screen and lobbies.
[*] [b]Separate tech trees.[/b] Each faction builds its own Construction Yard, MCV, War Factory and Helipad. Capture a rival's yard and you can build its arsenal too, with badges on the cameos showing which faction builds what. Unholy Alliance mode starts every player with an Allied, Soviet, GDI and Nod MCV.
[*] [b]Walls and gates![/b] Every faction has a gate that opens for its own units, and placing a wall in line with another of its kind, up to five cells away, fills the gap.
[*] [b]Tiberium.[/b] Fields grow and spread, hurt infantry and can raise visceroids. Most of Red Alert's own skirmish maps now mix Tiberium with ore.
[*] [b]Crates.[/b] The unit pool now covers every faction.
[*] [b]Computer opponents for all five factions[/b], each on its own Easy, Medium or Hard setting from the lobby. In 5.0 the AI fields a stronger economy and builds a navy on water maps. More AI work is to come.
[*] [b]Authentic sound:[/b] TD and TS EVA, unit voices, building and weapon sounds. Skirmish music mixes RA and TD tracks.
[*] [b]Quality of life:[/b] attack-move (Shift+click), rally points, A* pathfinding, harvesters that dock at any refinery, repair bay queueing and extra zoom levels (adapted from CFE Patch Redux). The Deploy key works on every faction's MCVs and transports, and select-all (A) leaves harvesters and MCVs out.
[/list]

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[b][u]Version 5.0.0[/u][/b]
Another Tiberian faction joins the fray! A Chronosphere accident tears a hole in time and drags GDI out of the future. A terrible accident, or an insidious plot by Kane?
[list]
[*] Tiberian Sun GDI, a fifth playable faction!
[*] All-new intro movie!
[*] UI overhaul!
[*] Gates and walls for every side!
[*] Tiberium on Red Alert's own maps!
[*] AI improvements!
[/list]
[b]Earlier versions[/b]
[list]
[*] 4.0 to 4.2.1: navies, the A-10, Stealth Generator and support powers, separate tech trees with capture, Unholy Alliance, per slot AI difficulty.
[*] 3.0: harvester economy overhaul with cross-faction refinery docking.
[*] 2.0 to 2.4: Tiberium, attack-move and A* pathfinding.
[/list]
Complete changelog on GitHub:
https://github.com/gibbo101/cnc-ra-tiberian-factions/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

[h2]Planned[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Tiberian Sun Nod[/b] as a playable faction.
[*] [b]A balance pass for TS GDI and TS Nod.[/b] 5.0 uses Tiberian Sun's exact values.
[*] [b]Smarter AI[/b], including naval invasions.
[*] [b]The Tiberian Dawn maps[/b] back as a separate download.
[*] [b]GDI and Nod campaigns.[/b]
[*] [b]Co-op missions[/b] for two players.
[/list]

[h2]Compatibility[/h2]
[list]
[*] This is a [b]DLL mod[/b]. It will not work alongside any other mod that also modifies RedAlert.dll. Disable other DLL mods such as CFE Patch before enabling this one.
[*] [b]HD graphics only.[/b] Classic graphics mode is locked out, because the mod's units and buildings have no classic art.
[*] Single-player skirmish is the main tested mode. LAN works, and every player gets their own faction's crest, EVA and hotkeys.
[*] Saved games from earlier versions of the mod will not load in 5.0.
[/list]

[h2]Known limitations[/h2]
[list]
[*] The TS GDI AI does not use Firestorm Defense or build the EMP Cannon, and builds no transports or navy on maps split by water (a TS GDI navy may come later).
[*] No faction's AI builds walls or gates.
[*] German and French players hear English voices while the mod is enabled.
[/list]

[h2]My other C&C projects[/h2]
[list]
[*] [url=https://github.com/gibbo101/renegade-pad]Renegade Pad[/url]: C&C Renegade's campaign played like a console shooter on the Steam Deck, with a full controller scheme.
[*] [url=https://github.com/gibbo101/opents-pad]OpenTS Pad[/url]: OpenTS, the open-source Tiberian Sun, on a controller, in the style of Red Alert: Retaliation on the PlayStation.
[*] [url=https://github.com/gibbo101/cnc-map-editor]C&C Remastered Map Editor[/url]: a Linux-native map editor for Red Alert and Tiberian Dawn that understands mods, Tiberian Factions included.
[*] [url=https://github.com/gibbo101/ps1-lan-link]PS1 Link Cable[/url]: two-player link-cable play between two Steam Decks over wifi, for Red Alert: Retaliation, Dune 2000 and more.
[/list]
